request.style: English, warm female solo voice, soft piano, acoustic guitar, cello, light percussion, hopeful mood, 75 BPM
request.lyrics:
[Verse]
What does it say to you and me
The word is near, so freely seen
In your mouth and in your heart
The word of faith is not apart

[Verse]
Confess with mouth that Jesus reigns
Believe in heart of God's domain
He raised Him up from death and night
So that we may see the light

[Chorus]
No one who believes in Him will be put to shame
The same Lord is Lord of all, He knows our name
He pours out riches on those who call on Him
Everyone who calls on the Lord will be saved

[Verse]
No distinction between Jew and Greek
The Lord is one, the Lord we seek
He is Lord of all without a doubt
His grace is here, His power is out

[Chorus]
No one who believes in Him will be put to shame
The same Lord is Lord of all, He knows our name
He pours out riches on those who call on Him
Everyone who calls on the Lord will be saved

[Bridge]
How can they call if they have not believed
How can they believe if not received
How can they hear without someone preaching
How can they preach without sending

[Chorus]
No one who believes in Him will be put to shame
The same Lord is Lord of all, He knows our name
He pours out riches on those who call on Him
Everyone who calls on the Lord will be saved

[Outro]
How beautiful are the feet that bring news
Of the Lord who is faithful and true
